t.en: Interpretations of Matrix Equations
t.zh: 矩阵方程的几种解释

t.en: The solution set to a system of linear equations, like
t.zh: 线性方程组的解集，例如

t.en: can be interpreted as the intersection of three planes (or hyperplanes if there were more variables). Each equation (each row) specifies a plane, and the solution set is the intersection of all of these planes. Rewriting a system of equations in matrix form gives two additional ways to interpret the solution set.
t.zh: 可以解释为三个平面（如果变量更多，则是超平面）的交。每个方程（每一行）确定一个平面，解集就是所有这些平面的交。把方程组写成矩阵形式后，又多了两种理解解集的方式。

t.en: The *Column* Picture
t.zh: *列*的观点

t.en: Using the column interpretation of matrix-vector multiplication, we see that system 〔引用〕 is equivalent to
t.zh: 利用矩阵与向量乘法的列解释，可以看出方程组〔引用〕等价于

t.en: We now see that asking, “\emphWhat coefficients allow $\mat{1\\2\\1}$, $\mat{2\\1\\-4}$, and $\mat{-2\\-5\\1}$ to form $\mat{-15\\-21\\18}$ as a linear combination?” is equivalent to asking, “*What are the solutions to system 〔引用〕?*” Here, $\mat{1\\2\\1}$, $\mat{2\\1\\-4}$, and $\mat{-2\\-5\\1}$ are the columns of the coefficient matrix.
The *Row* Picture
t.zh: *行*的观点

t.en: The row interpretation gives another perspective. Let $\vec r_1$, $\vec r_2$, and $\vec r_3$ be the rows of the coefficient matrix for system 〔引用〕. Then, system 〔引用〕 is equivalent to
t.zh: 行解释给出了另一个角度。设 $\vec r_1$、$\vec r_2$、$\vec r_3$ 是方程组〔引用〕的系数矩阵的各行，那么方程组〔引用〕等价于

blocks.tex:
\mat{1&2&-2\\2&1&-5\\1&-4&1}\mat{x\\y\\z}=
	\left[\begin{array}{c}\vec r_1\\\hline\vec r_2\\\hline\vec r_3\end{array}\right]\vec x=
	\mat{\vec r_1\cdot \vec x\\\vec r_2\cdot\vec x\\\vec r_3\cdot \vec x}
	     =\mat{-15\\-21\\18}.

t.en: In other words, we can interpret solutions to system 〔引用〕 as vectors whose dot product with $\vec r_1$ is $-15$, whose dot product with $\vec r_2$ is $-21$, and whose dot product with $\vec r_3$ is $18$. Given that the dot product has a geometric interpretation, this perspective is powerful (especially when the right side of the equation is all zeros!).
t.zh: 换句话说，方程组〔引用〕的解可以理解为这样的向量：它与 $\vec r_1$ 的点积为 $-15$，与 $\vec r_2$ 的点积为 $-21$，与 $\vec r_3$ 的点积为 $18$。点积有几何意义，所以这个角度很有威力（尤其是当方程右边全是零的时候！）。

t.en: Interpreting Homogeneous Systems
t.zh: 齐次方程组的解释

t.en: Consider the homogeneous system/matrix equation
t.zh: 考虑齐次方程组/矩阵方程

t.en: Now, the column interpretation of system 〔引用〕 is: \emphwhat linear combinations of the column vectors of $A$ give $\vec 0$? This directly relates to the question of whether the column vectors of $A$ are linearly independent.
t.zh: 现在，方程组〔引用〕的列解释是：$A$ 的列向量的哪些线性组合等于 $\vec 0$？这直接关系到 $A$ 的列向量是否线性无关这个问题。

t.en: Let $\vec r_1$, $\vec r_2$, and $\vec r_3$ be the rows of $A$. The row interpretation of system 〔引用〕 asks: \emphwhat vectors are simultaneously orthogonal to $\vec r_1$, $\vec r_2$, and $\vec r_3$?
t.zh: 设 $\vec r_1$、$\vec r_2$、$\vec r_3$ 是 $A$ 的各行。方程组〔引用〕的行解释问的是：哪些向量同时与 $\vec r_1$、$\vec r_2$、$\vec r_3$ 正交？

t.en: There are three ways to interpret solutions to a matrix equation $A\vec x=\vec b$: (i) the intersection of hyperplanes specified by the rows; (ii) what linear combinations of the columns of $A$ give $\vec b$; (iii) what vectors yield the entries of $\vec b$ when dot producted with the rows of $A$.
t.zh: 矩阵方程 $A\vec x=\vec b$ 的解有三种理解方式：（i）由各行确定的超平面的交；（ii）$A$ 的各列的哪些线性组合等于 $\vec b$；（iii）哪些向量与 $A$ 的各行做点积后，恰好得到 $\vec b$ 的各个分量。
